# Sigillion

> Lossless, local, provable memory for AI agents. Today a Claude Code plugin that keeps every session on the user's own computer, word for word, compressed and sealed in hash-chained segments so that a change shows, after compaction and after Claude Code deletes its transcripts; a brief at each session's start; recall of any earlier turn, each answer with a receipt. Claude Code first, every agent next, then legal and finance. Made by Steddy Nova SRL.

Sigillion is not open source. The packages are on PyPI: sigillion (the engine, compiled), sigillion-capture and sigillion-format (readable source). Install, on Windows or Linux x86_64 with Python 3.10 to 3.14 and Claude Code 2.1.287 or later: `pipx install --include-deps sigillion`, then `sigillion install`. Recording is free for good; reading back needs a licence after a 30-day trial; export always works. Nothing leaves the computer.
